import p2helpers as m,json,sys,hashlib,re,ast,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
W=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;R=W.parents[1];m.WORK=W/'run';m.WORK.mkdir(exist_ok=True);m.STAGE='P3-continuation-R1-readonly-mandatory-check'
m.REPORT={'base':'75955bb44eb2ba86da7d2c5f30ec947373e5099e','startedUtc':m.datetime.now(m.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'phase':m.STAGE,'commands':[],'checks':[],'ownedContainers':[],'removedContainers':[],'qaAccess':True,'productionAccess':False,'qaMutation':False,'apiStopped':False,'runtimeGateExecuted':False,'noBusinessRowsRead':True,'migratorReadOnly':True,'phraseNeeded':False}
password=None
SQL=ast.literal_eval(next(n.value for n in ast.parse((W/'original-catalog.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')).body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='SQL' for t in n.targets)))
META=r"""SELECT json_build_object(
'functions',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name',p.proname,'signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'source',p.prosrc,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'config',p.proconfig) ORDER BY p.proname) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND p.proname IN ('customer_access_relink','customer_booking_revision')),
'checks',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',k.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true),'validated',k.convalidated) ORDER BY k.conname) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid WHERE k.connamespace='public'::regnamespace AND k.conname IN ('Client_customer_revision_check','CustomerOperation_valid_check')),
'indexes',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name',indexname,'definition',indexdef) ORDER BY indexname) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='CustomerOperation'),
'triggers',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',t.tgname,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true),'enabled',t.tgenabled) ORDER BY t.tgname) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND t.tgname IN ('Client_customer_access_relink','Booking_customer_revision')),
'publicReceiptAcl',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable)),'[]'::json) FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a WHERE c.oid='public."CustomerOperation"'::regclass AND a.grantee=0)
);
SELECT json_build_object(
'prosrc',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(p.oid::regprocedure::text ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text),'[]'::json) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND strpos(p.prosrc,chr(13))>0),
'constraints',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(k.conname ORDER BY k.conname),'[]'::json) FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.connamespace='public'::regnamespace AND strpos(pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true),chr(13))>0),
'defaults',(SELECT coalesce(json_agg(c.relname||'.'||a.attname ORDER BY c.relname,a.attname),'[]'::json) FROM pg_attrdef d JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=d.adrelid JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum=d.adnum WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND strpos(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),chr(13))>0));
SELECT json_build_object('active',count(*) FILTER(WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL),'failed',count(*) FILTER(WHERE finished_at IS NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL),'migration28',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('migrationName',migration_name,'checksum',checksum,'finished',finished_at IS NOT NULL,'rolledBack',rolled_back_at IS NOT NULL,'appliedStepsCount',applied_steps_count)) FROM public."_prisma_migrations" WHERE migration_name='20261003120000_customer_stage_one')) FROM public."_prisma_migrations";
"""
def normalize_sql(raw,label):
 b=raw.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n');assert b'\r' not in b,'SQL-contains-CR-rejected-before-transmission'
 m.REPORT.setdefault('sqlStdinByteChecks',[]).append({'label':label,'sha256Before':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'sha256Sent':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b),'CRcount':b.count(b'\r'),'LFNormalizedAndRejectedBareCR':True});return b
# Production and other units are excluded; this reads only authorized QA service/image metadata.
def infra(label):
 raw=m.ssh("systemctl show kortek-api-staging kortek-email-worker-staging --property=Id,ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,NRestarts\nXDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 podman inspect --format '{{.Name}} {{.Image}} {{.State.Status}}' kortek-api-staging kortek-email-worker-staging",label=label).decode()
 assert raw.count('ActiveState=active')==2 and raw.count('SubState=running')==2 and raw.count('NRestarts=0')==2 and m.API_IMAGE in raw and m.WORKER_IMAGE in raw
 return raw
try:
 m.REPORT['initialInfra']=infra('READONLY-starting-QA-old-services-images')
 m.REPORT['initialEffective']=m.effective()
 prior=json.loads((R/'docs/quality/evidence/m2-c3-p3/p3-goal-20261004/freeze--result.json').read_bytes());paths=['apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261003120000_customer_stage_one/migration.sql','apps/api/ops/apply-runtime-grants.sql','apps/api/ops/customer-stage-one-runtime-grants.sql'];proof=[]
 for path,step in zip(paths,prior['realSqlSteps']):
  raw=(R/path).read_bytes();blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+path]);effective=b''.join(line for line in raw.splitlines(keepends=True) if not line.startswith(bytes([92])+b'ir '))
  proof.append({'file':path,'gitBlobSha256':hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),'workingSha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'historicalSourceSha256':step['sourceSha256'],'historicalSentSha256':step['effectiveSha256'],'reconstructedSentSha256':hashlib.sha256(effective).hexdigest(),'workingAndGitBytesEqual':raw==blob,'historicalSourceMatches':step['sourceSha256']==hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'historicalSentMatchesReconstruction':step['effectiveSha256']==hashlib.sha256(effective).hexdigest(),'reconstructedCRcount':effective.count(b'\r'),'removedOnlyInclude':step['removedOnlyInclude'],'historicalTransmissionProof':'historical executed source uses binary subprocess stdin with effective.encode(UTF-8), and recorded effective hash; no retained network packet capture'})
 m.REPORT['historicalSqlByteProof']=proof;expected=proof[0]['gitBlobSha256'];m.REPORT['expectedRepositoryMigrationChecksum']=expected
 line=sys.stdin.buffer.readline();password=bytearray(line.rstrip(b'\r\n'));line=None;assert password
 m.PG_ENV=dict(m.BASE_ENV,PGPASSWORD=password.decode(),PGHOST='aws-0-us-east-1.pooler.supabase.com',PGPORT='5432',PGUSER='kortek_migrator.'+m.REF,PGDATABASE='postgres',PGSSLMODE='verify-full',PGSSLROOTCERT='/tmp/qa-ca.crt',PGOPTIONS='-c default_transaction_read_only=on -c statement_timeout=120000',PGCLIENTENCODING='UTF8',PGAPPNAME='kortek-m2-c3-p3-R1-readonly');m.erase(password);password=None
 ca=R/'ops/oci-free-backup/prod-ca-2021.crt';assert hashlib.sha256(ca.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='1dcaafbf6fda7f21e34ff35825c1a1354408ea11e5839157e690af851c73453a'
 client=m.start('kortek-p3-R1-readonly-client-'+m.RUN,ca=True)
 payload=normalize_sql(('BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;\n'+SQL+'\n'+META+'\nCOMMIT;\n').encode('utf-8'),'READONLY-R1-catalog-and-technical-ledger')
 keys=['PGPASSWORD','PGHOST','PGPORT','PGUSER','PGDATABASE','PGSSLMODE','PGSSLROOTCERT','PGOPTIONS','PGAPPNAME','PGCLIENTENCODING'];out=m.docker('exec','-i',*sum((['-e',k] for k in keys),[]),client,'psql','-X','-qAt','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1',data=payload,env=m.PG_ENV,timeout=180,label='READONLY-TLS-verify-full-RR-catalog-and-ledger').decode('utf-8');rows=[json.loads(x) for x in out.splitlines() if x.strip()];assert len(rows)==4
 catalog,definitions,scan,ledger=rows;m.REPORT.update(catalog=catalog,definitions=definitions,carriageReturnScan=scan,ledger=ledger)
 assert catalog['session']['user']=='kortek_migrator' and catalog['session']['readOnly']=='on' and catalog['session']['isolation']=='repeatable read'
 assert len([x for x in catalog['relations'] if x['kind']=='r'])==37 and ledger['active']==28 and ledger['failed']==0
 checksumRows=ledger['migration28'];matches=len(checksumRows)==1 and checksumRows[0]['checksum']==expected;m.REPORT['ledgerChecksumComparison']={'expectedRepositoryLF':expected,'observedQa':checksumRows,'equal':matches,'historicalRegistration':'Prisma migrate resolve --applied after 3 successful SQL steps, executed using CRLF migration from ARM64 image; no manual ledger SQL','historicalArtifactSha256':prior['migrationWorkingVsArtifactEol']['artifactSha256'],'qaChecksumMatchesHistoricalImageArtifact':len(checksumRows)==1 and checksumRows[0]['checksum']==prior['migrationWorkingVsArtifactEol']['artifactSha256']}
 before=json.loads((R/'docs/quality/evidence/m2-c3-p3/p3-goal-20261004/catalog-result.json').read_bytes())['catalog']['relations']
 def acl(rows):
  return {x['name']:{'kind':x['kind'],'owner':x['owner'],'acl':sorted(x['acl'].strip('{}').split(',')) if x['acl'] else x['acl']} for x in rows}
 oldAcl=acl(before);observedAcl=acl([x for x in catalog['relations'] if x['name']!='CustomerOperation']);m.REPORT['oldAclComparison']={'before':oldAcl,'observed':observedAcl,'equal':oldAcl==observedAcl,'normalization':'entry ordering only; no privilege removal or grant-option normalization'}
 m.REPORT['R1passed']=matches and not any(scan.values()) and all(x['workingAndGitBytesEqual'] and x['historicalSourceMatches'] and x['historicalSentMatchesReconstruction'] and x['reconstructedCRcount']==0 for x in proof)
 m.REPORT['catalogComparisonWithHistoricalGeneralRehearsalLimit']='Post-upgrade pg_get_functiondef/constraintdef/index definitions were not retained by historical rehearsal; current catalog archived, direct historical byte comparison unavailable. Do not substitute inferred identity for captured evidence.'
 m.REPORT['finalInfra']=infra('READONLY-end-QA-service-PID-image-metadata');assert m.REPORT['finalInfra']==m.REPORT['initialInfra'];m.REPORT['servicesUnchangedDuringReads']=True
 m.REPORT['readOnlyChecksCompleted']=True;m.REPORT['mandatoryStop']=not m.REPORT['R1passed'];m.REPORT['success']=True
 m.emit('READONLY-R1-completed-mandatory-stop',repositoryChecksum=expected,observedQaChecksum=checksumRows[0]['checksum'],equal=matches,CRfindings=scan,QAservicesUnchanged=True,R2executed=False,R4executed=False)
except Exception as e:m.retain_failure(e);m.emit('R1-readonly-executor-failed',failure=m.failure_info(e))
finally:
 m.erase(password)
 if m.PG_ENV:m.PG_ENV['PGPASSWORD']='';m.PG_ENV.clear();m.PG_ENV=None
 m.cleanup();m.REPORT['finishedUtc']=m.datetime.now(m.timezone.utc).isoformat();m.save()
raise SystemExit(0 if m.REPORT.get('readOnlyChecksCompleted') else 1)

param()
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$qaCatalogRoot=Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$qaRepoRoot=Split-Path -Parent $qaCatalogRoot
$qaCredential=$null;$qaProcess=$null;$qaPtr=[IntPtr]::Zero;$qaPlain=$null
try {
 $qaCredential=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $qaRepoRoot '.tmp/base-preprod-c1/supabase-qa-migrator.dpapi') -Raw | ConvertTo-SecureString
 $qaInfo=[Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
 $qaInfo.FileName='C:/Users/Fraylin/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/python.exe'
 $qaInfo.ArgumentList.Add('-u');$qaInfo.ArgumentList.Add((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'catalog.py'))
 $qaInfo.WorkingDirectory=$qaRepoRoot;$qaInfo.UseShellExecute=$false
 $qaInfo.RedirectStandardInput=$true;$qaInfo.RedirectStandardOutput=$true;$qaInfo.RedirectStandardError=$true
 $qaInfo.StandardInputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
 $qaProcess=[Diagnostics.Process]::new();$qaProcess.StartInfo=$qaInfo;[void]$qaProcess.Start()
 $qaErrors=$qaProcess.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync();$qaOutput=$qaProcess.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
 $qaPtr=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($qaCredential)
 $qaPlain=[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringBSTR($qaPtr)
 $qaProcess.StandardInput.WriteLine($qaPlain);$qaProcess.StandardInput.Flush();$qaProcess.StandardInput.Close()
 $qaPlain=$null;[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($qaPtr);$qaPtr=[IntPtr]::Zero
 $qaProcess.WaitForExit();$qaExit=$qaProcess.ExitCode
 $qaText=$qaOutput.GetAwaiter().GetResult();$qaErrorText=$qaErrors.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
 Write-Output $qaText
 if ($qaErrorText.Length -gt 0) {
  $qaErrorText=$qaErrorText -replace '(?i)postgres(?:ql)?://\S+','[DB URL omitted]'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'supervisor-stderr.txt'),$qaErrorText,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
  Write-Output $qaErrorText
 }
 exit $qaExit
} finally {
 if ($qaPtr -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) {[Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($qaPtr)}
 $qaPlain=$null
 if ($qaCredential) {$qaCredential.Dispose()}
 if ($qaProcess) {$qaProcess.Dispose()}
 [GC]::Collect()
}
